message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train options in Miami** | Location | Train Service | Pet Policy | |----------|---------------|------------| | **Miami Central Station (Amtrak)** | Amtrak’s *Silver Service* (Florida Rail) | Pets are allowed on most Amtrak trains, but there are restrictions:
• Only one pet per passenger (unless you’re traveling with a service animal).
• The pet must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• A small fee (usually $25–$35) applies per pet.
• Some routes may have additional rules, so it’s best to check the specific train’s policy before booking. | ### Quick notes - **Station facilities** – The station itself doesn’t have a “pet‑friendly” designation; it’s the trains that accommodate pets. - **Booking** – When you book your ticket, you’ll see an option to add a pet. Make sure to bring a carrier that meets Amtrak’s size requirements. - **Other services** – If you’re looking for a pet‑friendly environment at the station (e.g., a place to walk your dog), the station’s parking lot and surrounding sidewalks are open to pets, but there aren’t dedicated pet‑friendly amenities inside the building. If you need more detailed information about a particular Amtrak route or want to confirm the latest pet policy, let me know!
